subject: Thanks for reaching out
body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Thanks for reaching out and for your interest in Agentway.

We help consumer brands automate the manual back-office work that usually lives across spreadsheets, inboxes, ERPs, order systems, CX tools, and finance workflows.

I’ll send occasional notes on what we’re seeing across ecommerce ops, AI automation, and the workflows brands are still doing manually.

Best,
Sabeen

subject: Looking forward to connecting
body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Thanks for booking time. Looking forward to learning more about what your team is doing manually today and where Agentway may be useful.

The most helpful thing for our call is usually a quick walkthrough of one workflow your team still handles by hand — spreadsheets, inboxes, order entry, reporting, CX exceptions, ERP updates, anything like that.

See you soon,
Sabeen

subject: Great connecting
body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Great connecting today. I enjoyed learning more about how your team is handling {{workflow_area}}.

As discussed, the easiest next step is usually a short screen share of the manual process so we can understand the workflow, the systems involved, and where automation could create the most leverage.

From there, we can usually put together a lightweight prototype pretty quickly.

Best,
Sabeen
